name: Dotmac Academy
description: Confidential server-side relying party for academy.dotmac.io staff sign-in (pilot cohort). Same security model as dotmac-workspace: a server-held secret, an HttpOnly cookie and a server-side single-use state store. The secret itself lives ONLY in OpenBao; see docs/SECRETS.md. Declared disabled until the Academy OIDC build is deployed with its secret delivered; see the rollout gate in realm/expected-clients.json.
